CCM.Name: 181 Partial Reserve for Part 1
CCM.Memo:
SysEx message. Changes the amount of reserved partials for the part.
The effect will not apply until all the messages of
partial reserve of parts 1~9 have been received.
You can do that all at once by sending the following SysEx: F0h 41h 10h 16h 12h [ 10h 00h 04h P1 P2 P3 P4 P5 P6 P7 P8 DP ] F7h
Where: Pn is the corresponding part and DP is drum part.

CCM.Name: 142 Display Reset
CCM.Memo:
SysEx message. Resets the display to its default state.
You can display a message via the following SysEx event:
F0h 41h 10h 16h 12h [ 20h 00h xxh "message" ] F7h
xxh is the offset from the first position on the display.
NOTE: A message must not be longer than 20 characters.
